hero.heading: We want to solve every writer's problem.
hero.subtitle: doXmind is an AI-native writing platform designed from the ground up to remove every barrier between a writer and their best work.

vision.label: Our Vision
vision.heading: The future of writing is intelligent
vision.p1: We believe every piece of writing should have the benefit of an intelligent partner. Not to write for you, but to provide exactly the right help at every step — from initial inspiration to final polish.
vision.p2: doXmind brings AI into the core of the writing experience. Your research materials, writing style, and creative intent — the AI understands it all and offers suggestions accordingly. One platform for the entire journey from research and drafting to revision and publishing.
vision.p3: This isn't the future — it's what we're building right now.

problem.label: The Problem
problem.heading: Writing tools weren't built for writers
problem.subtitle: For decades, writing software has been designed around formatting and layout — not around the act of thinking and communicating. Writers are left juggling multiple disconnected tools.

fragmentedTools.title: Fragmented tools
fragmentedTools.description: Writers bounce between a word processor, a research tool, a grammar checker, and an AI chatbot. Context is lost at every switch, and flow is constantly interrupted.

aiBoltedOn.title: AI bolted on, not built in
aiBoltedOn.description: Most editors treat AI as an afterthought — a sidebar or a separate app. The AI doesn't understand your document structure, writing style, or true intent.

noMemory.title: No memory, no knowledge
noMemory.description: Your AI assistant forgets everything between sessions. It can't reference your research materials, style guides, or previous work.

approach.label: Our Approach
approach.heading: AI-native from the ground up
approach.subtitle: In doXmind, AI isn't a separate tool you invoke — it's woven into every part of the writing experience.

aiWoven.title: AI woven into every keystroke
aiWoven.description: In doXmind, AI is embedded in every part of the writing experience. Autocomplete suggests as you type. Select text to instantly rewrite, translate, or refine. Chat with AI about your entire document.

distractionFree.title: A distraction-free canvas
distractionFree.description: We stripped away everything that doesn't help you write. No ribbon toolbars. No menu mazes. Just a clean editor with intelligent tools that appear exactly when you need them.

knowledgeConnected.title: Your knowledge, always connected
knowledgeConnected.description: Upload research papers, style guides, and reference documents. The AI reads them, cites them, and grounds every suggestion in your actual materials. Your writing gains the depth of your research.

writerFirst.title: Writer-first, always
writerFirst.description: Every feature we build starts with one question: does this make a writer's life easier? If it doesn't, we don't ship it.

aiAsPartner.title: AI as partner, not replacement
aiAsPartner.description: AI should amplify your voice, not replace it. Every AI edit is a suggestion you control — accept, reject, or refine.

yourData.title: Your data, your work
yourData.description: Your documents and knowledge base belong to you. We don't train on your content. Your writing stays private.

simplicity.title: Simplicity is a feature
simplicity.description: Complexity is the enemy of creativity. We obsess over removing friction so you can focus on what matters: your ideas.

cta.heading: Start writing with AI today
cta.subtitle: Join thousands of writers who've already discovered a better way to write. Free to start, no credit card required.
